persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a silent 6-second widescreen clip. Start with a dark green title card saying exactly “A quieter kind of morning” in cream lettering for 2 seconds, then cut to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise. No other text.
bank.Title wording: A quieter kind of morning — exactly this capitalization, without quotation marks.
bank.Title styling and timing: Cream lettering on a dark green title card for the first 2 seconds; font and layout are your call.
bank.Scene after the title: A slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise.

messages.text: Could you make a clip that starts with a dark green title card with cream lettering, then cuts to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise? I’ve been craving a little moment of calm, which is why this idea appeals to me. The title should say exactly “A quieter kind of morning,” with that capitalization and without the quotation marks or the comma, and stay on screen for the first 2 seconds. The whole clip should be 6 seconds long, in 16:9 widescreen, and completely silent. I’m probably over-explaining because I’m excited about how peaceful it could feel. Please don’t include any other text; the title’s font and layout are your call.
